rules: Headings must use tight letter spacing.
Labels and overlines must be tiny, uppercase, and widely tracked.
Line height must be tight for headers (leading-none) and loose for body (leading-relaxed).
Never use Inter, Roboto, or Space Grotesk.
Use high contrast for text to meet APCA standards.
Avoid teal or purple for main CTA. Use Pure Black or Vibrant Terracotta.
Colors convey status (e.g., Match Scores) rather than just decoration.

layout_and_spacing.strategy: The Control Room Grid (Mode B) + Neo-Brutalist Grid Borders
layout_and_spacing.container_padding: Containers with borders must have generous internal padding (p-6).
rules: No soft rounded shadows. Use sharp 1px borders with solid color backgrounds.
Every pixel utilized, use h-full on children.
Ensure optical alignment over geometrical alignment.

surfaces.cards: Flat solid background, sharp 1px dark border (#1E1E1E), no shadow. On hover: slight lift (-translate-y-1) and hard solid shadow (4px 4px 0px #1E1E1E).
surfaces.header: Solid background (#FDFBF7) with a hard 1px bottom border.
surfaces.modals: Solid white background, 2px dark border, hard solid shadow.
surfaces.badges: Pill shaped or sharp rectangles. High contrast text over pastel background.

motion.hover_states: Hard brutalist shift: add a hard drop-shadow and translate-x-[-2px] translate-y-[-2px] on interactive elements.
motion.transitions: Fast and snappy. transition: transform 0.15s ease, box-shadow 0.15s ease.
motion.page_load: Staggered fade and slide up for dashboard widgets.

components.buttons: Custom HTML/Tailwind buttons for main CTAs. Sharp borders, strong typography. For standard operations, use Shadcn Button but override rounded corners to rounded-none or rounded-sm, and replace soft shadows with hard shadows.
components.inputs: Shadcn Form/Input/Select. Override to have sharp corners and 1px dark borders. Focus state: ring-2 ring-black ring-offset-2.
components.tables: Shadcn Table for Kanban or Job Lists. Use solid row borders.
components.charts: Recharts / Shadcn Charts for resume match insights and tracking. Minimal styling, match the pastel/brutalist theme.
components.icons: @phosphor-icons/react for dense dashboard UI. Use regular or bold weights to match the strong typography.

images.description: Warm, inspiring office space with soft lighting for the Google Sign-in landing page.

rules: Never use placeholder URLs (like via.placeholder.com). Use the provided image URLs.
Ensure hero images have an appropriate overlay if text is placed on top (e.g., bg-white/40 for light theme) so text remains readable.

accessibility.testing_attributes: All interactive elements MUST have a data-testid attribute (e.g., data-testid='job-apply-button').
accessibility.contrast: Ensure minimum 4.5:1 ratio for normal text. Avoid light grey text on white.
accessibility.focus: All focusable elements must have visible focus rings (e.g., focus-visible:ring-2 focus-visible:ring-offset-2).

pages_and_features.landing_page: Google sign-in gate. Warm hero image background. A clean, brutalist centered card with sharp borders and the Sign-in button.
pages_and_features.dashboard_main: Bento-style layout. Top row: Key metrics (Total Applied, Interviewing, Avg Match Score). Main area: Data-dense Job Grid (Australia focus). Right column or hidden panel: 5 Uploaded Resumes summary.
pages_and_features.job_card: Includes Title, Company, Location, Salary, Source (SEEK, LinkedIn), Posted Time. Hero visual: A massive, color-coded Match Score (0-100%). Button: 'Apply' which dynamically indicates the best matching resume.
pages_and_features.kanban_tracker: Columns for Saved, Applied, Interview, Offer, Rejected. Pastel column backgrounds with sharp card items.
pages_and_features.resume_manager: List of up to 5 resumes with role tags. Insights modal/section for Gap Analysis vs JD.
pages_and_features.filters_panel: Sidebar or top bar command-palette style filters for Location, Salary, Role Type, Source, Match Threshold, Graduate Programs.

instructions_to_main_agent: Strictly follow the typography choices: Cabinet Grotesk and IBM Plex Sans. Use JetBrains Mono for data points or scores if needed.
Install the Phosphor Icons library (yarn add @phosphor-icons/react).
Do not use generic Shadcn soft shadows; replace them with hard box-shadows (e.g., 'shadow-[4px_4px_0px_#1E1E1E]') for the Neo-Brutalist feel.
Ensure the match score is the prominent visual element in the Job Cards.
Integrate a command palette / filters approach for managing data density.
Ensure layout strictly uses Tailwind grid without deeply nested unaligned containers.
